name: Eribulin (single-agent) for Liposarcoma
cyclesNote: continue to progression or unacceptable toxicity; eribulin has a survival benefit specifically in liposarcoma after an anthracycline. Physician determines duration.

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Soft Tissue Sarcoma (general reference)

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Eribulin is a histology-directed later-line agent with a demonstrated survival benefit in liposarcoma after anthracycline. Not molecularly biomarker-restricted.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: eribulin is low-to-moderate emetic risk; give antiemetic prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.

supportiveCare: CBC before each dose; neutropenia is the dominant toxicity, hold for significant neutropenia or thrombocytopenia.
assess peripheral neuropathy before each dose; hold or reduce for grade 2 to 3.
monitor QT in patients with electrolyte abnormalities or on QT-prolonging drugs; correct potassium and magnesium.
monitoring: electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) and QT as indicated

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, or grade 2 or worse neuropathy
doseModificationRules.text: Hold until recovery then resume at a reduced dose per standard eribulin reduction steps (1.4 to 1.1 to 0.7 mg/m2). Physician decides.

drugs.name: Eribulin
drugs.notes: Eribulin (mesylate) 1.4 mg/m2 IV over 2 to 5 minutes on days 1 and 8 every 21 days, single-agent. Standard dosing for advanced liposarcoma after anthracycline. Dose per the engine from patient BSA. General reference (NCCN / DeVita); own wording, DRAFT.
